summary: Five of the six news-surface CodeQL alerts this lane triaged in Wave 33 are still open, and the fix is now a one-line import swap at each of the four remaining call sites. The root-cause helper the Wave 33 dispositions always required was written and tested in Wave 34: lib/news/text-sanitize.ts exports toPlainText, which decodes entities in ONE semicolon-terminated pass, strips markup second, and then removes any residual < or >, so the returned string cannot contain a markup delimiter for any input. components/feed/rss-news-item.tsx (alert #43) was switched to it and is fixed. Addressed to the orchestrator rather than to a single domain because the four remaining files span four ownership claims: app/api/feed/rss-news/route.ts is the feed surface (social), lib/services/rss-feed.service.ts is explicitly lib/services/** (design-system), lib/opportunities/rss-opportunities-service.ts is jobs/opportunities (work), and components/news/news-page.tsx is news charter but was excluded from this wave's discover file ownership. discover cannot edit any of them and did not try.
